content: Yoɑsi u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Yehun bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiruse sɔɔrɑ Yoɑsi u bɑndu di Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. U mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru sɑɑ ye sɔɔ. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ weeru bɑn te sɔɔ. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Sibiɑ Beri Sebɑɡii.
Yoɑsi wi, u kuɑwɑ ye yɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃re win wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ. Yerɑ u yɑ̃ku kowo Yehoyɑdɑn sɔ̃ɔsiru wurɑ.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ ɡunɡuu ni kɔsuke nìn mi bɑ rɑ bũnu sɑ̃. Domi tɔmbɑ rɑ n dɑɑmɔ mi bɑ n bũu ni sɑ̃ɑmɔ kpɑ bɑ n turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokemɔ.
Yoɑsi u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru sɔnwɑ

Yoɑsi u derɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru sɔnwɑ mɑ u yɑ̃ku kowobu mɛnnɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu ɡobi mɔɔ yi bɑ kɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔ̃. Yiyɑ yi bɑ rɑɑ bɑɑwure bure win wɑ̃ɑrun sɔ̃, kɑ sere mɑɑ yi ɡɑbɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke bɑ wɛ̃ kɑ nuku tiɑ.
U nɛɛ, bu yi kpuro mɔɔ beɡibun min di. Kpɑ bu yi dendi bu kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔmɛ mi tɑ sɑnkirɑ.
Adɑmɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be, bɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔnwɑ sere n kɑ kuɑ sinɑ boko Yoɑsin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ itɑse.

Yerɑ sinɑ boko u yɑ̃ku kowo Yehoyɑdɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be bɑ tie sokɑ. Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i ǹ sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔnwɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i ku rɑ mɑɑ ɡobi ɡɛɛ mwɑ tɔmbun min di, bɛɛn tiin sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ i ko yi deriwɑ i kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔmɛ.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be, bɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke bu ku mɑɑ tɔn ben ɡobi mwɑ, kpɑ bu ku mɑɑ bu sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔmbun sɔmburu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.

Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo Yehoyɑdɑ u kpɑkoro piibu ɡɑɡu kuɑ, u ɡu yɑbɑ wɔllɔ. Mɑ u dɑ u yi yɑ̃ku yerun bɔkuɔ, nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ, Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔwɔ. Gobi yi tɔmbɑ kɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔ̃, mi sɔɔrɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te kɔ̃su bɑ rɑ yi kpɛ̃ɛ.
Bɑ̀ n wɑ ɡobi yi, yi dɑbiɑ kpɑkoro te sɔɔ, yerɑ bɑ rɑ sunɔn tire yoro kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero sokusie bu yi ɡurɑ bu ɡɑri.
Kpɑ bu yi be bɑ koo sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔmburu ko nɔmɑ bɛriɑ. Yiyɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃kobu kɔsiɑ, kɑ nɔmɑn sɔm kowobu,
kɑ bɑnɔbu, kɑ be bɑ kpenu dɑ̃kumɔ. Yi sɔɔrɑ bɑ kɑ mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ dwɑ kɑ kpenu kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ koo kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔmɛ kpuro ɡesi.

Adɑmɑ bɑɑ yin ɡɛɛ, bɑ ǹ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten dendi yɑ̃nu dwɑ nɡe ɡbɛ̃ɑ ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ sii ɡeesu ǹ kun mɛ wobunu, ǹ kun mɛ nɔri, ǹ kun mɛ kɔbi, ǹ kun mɛ dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ, ǹ kun mɛ kɑ sii ɡeesu.
Be bɑ sɔmbu te mɔ̀, beyɑ bɑ yi wɛ̃ bɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔnwɑ.
Bɑ ku rɑ bu bikie nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ ɡobi yi dendisinɑmɔ. Domi bɑ ye kpuro mɔ̀wɑ dee dee.
Gobi yi bɑ rɑ wɛ̃ yɑɑ sɑberun ɑyerɔ, torɑrun yɑ̃kurun sɔ̃ bɑ ku rɑ yi yi Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔ̃. Yiyɑ yi rɑ ko yɑ̃ku kowoɡii.
Yoɑsin bɑndun kpeeru
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Sirin sinɑ boko Hɑsɑɛli u Gɑti wɔri. Mɑ u ye mwɑ. Yen biru u ɡɔ̃ru doke u dɑ u Yerusɑlɛmu mwɑ.

Yerɑ Yoɑsi Yudɑn sinɑ boko u yɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu ɡurɑ ni win tii u yi Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃, kɑ sere ni win bɑɑbɑbɑ Yosɑfɑti kɑ Yorɑmu kɑ Akɑsiɑ bɑ yi, kɑ mɑɑ wurɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɑrumɑnin beru yerɔ, kɑ sere ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ. Ye kpurowɑ u suɑ u Hɑsɑɛli Sirin sinɑ boko mɔrisiɑ. Mɑ Hɑsɑɛli wi, u ǹ mɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmu wɔri.
Ye Yoɑsi u kuɑn sukum mu yoruɑ Yudɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.

N deemɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu Yosɑkɑɑ Simɛɑtin bii, kɑ Yosɑbɑdi Somɛɛn bii, beyɑ bɑ nùn seesi bɑ ɡo Milon dirɔ Silɑn wɔwɑɔ. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ Dɑfidin wuuɔ. Mɑ win bii Amɑsiɑ u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Yoɑkɑsi u kuɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko
